page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.24xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 96 dedicated physical cores and 96 vCPUs, utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with an Intel Xeon 8369HB processor operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. With a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, each vCPU maps to a dedicated physical core, eliminating resource contention from hyperthreading.

The instance is configured with 768.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. Additionally, the instance does not feature any GPU hardware accelerators.

Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps. Given the high memory capacity and dedicated CPU allocation, this instance is designed for memory-intensive workloads. Suitable applications include large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, enterprise resource planning applications, and high-performance computing tasks requiring substantial memory footprints without local storage dependencies.
